narrative:
## Handover Summary — Sales Plan

Transactions and basket validated by store, brand and channel; ML proposals accepted or overridden by store controllers.

## Key Decisions
• Ski sales in Trøndelag conditional on the DC re-allocation
• Anton Sport Black Friday planned at a 30% depth cap
• Club & Team B2B orders for the spring season added

## Recommendation for Margin Phase
Book the markdown reserve on aged summer outdoor stock before re-forecasting gross margin.

signals.excerpt: Intersport Trondheim City Syd and Solsiden have 2.1 weeks of alpine and cross-country cover against a 6-week target before week 50. Estimated sales at risk NOK 8.6M (NOK 3.2M gross margin) unless DC stock is re-allocated from Oslo this week.
